snippet.title: WARDOGS | Gamescom Trailer
snippet.description:
WARDOGS is available to pre-order now.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1867240/WARDOGS/

WARDOGS | Gamescom Trailer shown at Future Games Show to remind the wider gaming sphere that WARDOGS is releasing into Early Access, September 10th 2026.

Make sure you tune in to The FPS Games Show on September 3rd 18:00 UTC the for our major WARDOGS reveal. If you have pre-ordered WARDOGS or liked last weekends beta... you will not want miss it.
